title: UrduBERT: Transformer for Regional Languages
description: A BERT-based foundation model fine-tuned on 40M+ tokens of Urdu corpus from newspapers, social media, and literature, achieving SOTA on downstream NLP tasks.

title: RoboSight: Real-Time Object Detection for Drones
description: Lightweight YOLOv8-based pipeline deployed on edge hardware for autonomous aerial reconnaissance with sub-20ms inference latency.

title: MedScan AI: Chest X-Ray Pathology Detection
description: Deep learning model trained on CheXNet benchmarks to detect 14 thoracic pathologies from chest radiographs with radiologist-level accuracy.

title: SmartGrid AI: Demand Forecasting
description: An LSTM-Transformer hybrid model for predicting peak electricity demand in Pakistan's national grid to optimize load balancing.

title: Automated Plagiarism Detection for Urdu Text
description: FYDP leveraging semantic embeddings to detect paraphrased and cross-lingual plagiarism in Urdu academic documents.

title: Sign Language Interpreter using MediaPipe
description: Real-time Pakistani Sign Language recognition system using hand landmark detection and a custom gesture classifier.

title: Generative Scene Synthesis for Autonomous Vehicles
description: MS thesis developing a diffusion model-based synthetic data pipeline for training autonomous vehicle perception systems in low-resource settings.
